repos.name: t8y2/dbx
repos.description: 25 MB lightweight cross-platform database client for 100+ databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, DuckDB, SQL Server, and Dameng. Built-in AI, MCP Server, CLI, desktop and Docker. | 轻量级跨平台数据库管理工具，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB、达梦等 100+ 数据库，提供桌面端、Docker、CLI、内置 AI 助手和 MCP。
repos.one_liner: A lightweight, cross-platform database client featuring built-in AI and MCP server capabilities.
bullets: Built with Rust for high performance and a compact 25MB footprint.
Supports 100+ database types including DuckDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
Integrates AI-driven query assistance and an MCP server for agentic workflows.
Ideal for database administrators and developers needing a unified interface for polyglot data environments.

repos.name: Niko1221/Strata
repos.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B MoE) on a 12-24 GB NVIDIA GPU + 64 GB RAM: one-click install for Windows / Linux. Strata inference engine, OpenAI/Anthropic API on localhost, optional image input.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance inference engine enabling large MoE models to run on consumer-grade hardware.
bullets: C++ based inference engine optimized for 12-24GB VRAM and 64GB RAM configurations.
Supports local hosting of large models like Qwen3.8-Flash-Next with OpenAI/Anthropic API compatibility.
Enables private, low-latency LLM deployment without relying on external cloud providers.
Perfect for quant researchers or developers building local AI-driven trading or analysis tools.

repos.one_liner: An open-source platform for personal AI agents that operate autonomously on local machines.
bullets: TypeScript-based Mac application integrating OpenAI models with the Composio ecosystem.
